job.job_title: AI Full Stack Developer - Fully Opportunity
job.job_description:
We are seeking a highly experienced AI Full Stack Developer with deep expertise in architecting and building enterprise-grade Generative AI, Agentic AI, and full-stack applications. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience implementing LLM-powered platforms, RAG pipelines, AI agent frameworks, and cloud-native microservices using Azure, AWS, and modern full-stack technologies.
This role requires a developer who can seamlessly merge AI engineering, backend/frontend development, cloud architecture, and data engineering to deliver intelligent, scalable, and secure solutions.

Required Skills & Experience
Technical Expertise
10+ years of full-stack development using .NET, C#, Python, Node.js, Angular, React.
Strong hands-on experience with Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, AI Agent frameworks, and vector search.
Mastery in cloud engineering especially Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure ML.
Experience building CI/CD, DevSecOps, and secure cloud infrastructures.
Proficiency in relational and NoSQL databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle, MySQL, MongoDB, Cosmos DB).
AI/ML Tools & Frameworks
Azure Cognitive Services Azure AI Search Hugging Face LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras
